items.prompt: Orthographic top-down architectural plan photograph of a real built film set, taken straight down from high above: camera axis exactly perpendicular to the ground; no wall face, no elevation, no side of any building, wall, hedge or tree trunk is visible; only the ground plane, the top edges of walls and hedges and the tops of trees, furniture and objects are seen. The top of the image is north. Plan of the sunny far edge of a formal garden, a 26 by 15 metre area in an Art Nouveau dream after Alphonse Mucha, built as a real set. Near the top of the image, running the whole width, a tall clipped dark yew hedge seen from above as a thick flat-topped green band, with one arched gap cut through it about 70 percent from the left. Between the hedge and the ha-ha lies a strip of unmown long golden seeding grass with poppies, cornflowers and moon daisies, drifting in soft combed curves; in its centre a large oval hollow where the grass is pressed flat like a nest. About three quarters of the way down, a straight dry-stone ha-ha wall runs the whole width, seen only as its thin pale coping line with a narrow inlaid gold-and-pastel mosaic band; at its left end, on the wall line, a square limestone gate-pier seen from above as its square cap with a small weathered lichened stone griffin statue crouched on it inside a carved round halo disc. Below the ha-ha the ground is lower, rough pale grass that fades into bright hazy light toward the bottom edge. Warm low late-afternoon sun from the west-north-west (upper left), soft shadows toward the east. The set is empty: no people, no animals, no creatures, no text, no labels, no arrows, no symbols, no map legend. A clean, sharp, evenly exposed photographic plan in which every feature named above is clearly readable in its stated position. Photorealistic live-action fantasy film rooted in England in 1862, shot on 35mm film with anamorphic lenses, 16:9 widescreen. Real sets, real locations and real costumed actors in 1862 dress. Wonderland spaces are real built sets and set extensions in an Alphonse Mucha-inspired Art Nouveau design: flowing organic lines, floral and vine ornament, circular halo roundels, mosaic and stained glass, aged pastel-and-gold surfaces with patina and moss; the waking 1862 meadow stays plain period realism. Talking animals and fantastical creatures are photoreal CGI animals with naturalistic anatomy, real fur, feathers, skin and scales, lit by the same light and grounded with real contact shadows. Natural and practical light: sunlight, candlelight and oil lamps, soft haze with volumetric light shafts and soft colour through stained glass. Restrained palette of verdigris teal, slate grey, dusty rose, soft sage and lilac pastels and tarnished-gold accents, warmed by amber sun and candle glow. Fine film grain, gentle halation, soft depth of field, grounded and quietly melancholy.
